rule: A runner that takes a ticket delivers it. Valid leaves only: provider outage, TOO HARD (brain up one step), runner removed, Valentin's own call. Every other leave, from the second run on, wakes a Sonnet fixer that fixes the cause at its source.

valid.label: Provider outage
valid.detail: api error|(?:http|status|error|code)[ :=]{0,3}5\d\d\b|\b5\d\d (?:server error|service unavailable|bad gateway|from the provider)|rate.?limit|quota|overloaded|model (?:is )?unreachable|provider (?:busy|outage|down|unreachable)
valid.then: the same runner resumes when the provider is back; an outage over 30 minutes: the same brain on another plan takes it

valid.label: TOO HARD
valid.then: fleet/park --too-hard raises the brain tag one step; a stronger runner takes it; at extra-hard it goes to the lead lane

valid.label: Runner removed
valid.then: the ticket goes back to the queue as an orphan

valid.label: Valentin's own call
valid.detail: valentin review|needs valentin|question to valentin|waiting on valentin
valid.then: Valentin Review plus one marked Question; the runner keeps ownership

invalid.WAIT_CHECK: Waited on checks, release or timer
invalid.FAULT: Fault: no end note, died, run limit, unknown end state

phases.rule: Every model run on a ticket, the reviewer's too, is a run. Fine runs are the phases below. Every other run is a violation. No cap on Fix or QA runs.
phases.alarm: Violations per Product ticket. Runs per Product ticket is information only: never an alarm, an investigation or a fixer.
